description: Change messages in one account: mark read/unread, star/unstar, archive (remove from Inbox), move back to Inbox, or add/remove labels (by label name or id; for IMAP accounts labels are folders). Accepts up to 1000 message ids at once. Never deletes anything.

account.description: Account alias or email address. Omit to use the default account. No accounts connected yet.

addLabels.description: Label names or ids to add.

archive.description: Remove from Inbox (the mail stays in All Mail / Archive).

removeLabels.description: Label names or ids to remove.

name: modify_emails
title: Label / mark / archive emails
